verdict.rationale: Warp's own materials say the Warp Agent handles onboarding, and the API stores worker bank accounts and lets you create and send candidate offers. None of this describes a self-serve new-hire flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one. Missing for 10: documented self-serve new-hire onboarding flow, W-4 collection, I-9 collection, new-hire bank detail entry before start date, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send a new hire a self-serve onboarding flow that collects W-4, I-9, and bank details before day one

citations.quote: Warp Agent takes onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits.
List stored worker bank accounts, newest first.
Create and send offers, list existing offers, and manage their lifecycle.
